competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a units-aware calculation worksheet.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a seeded simulation with an explicit environment version.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include the simulator config, seed band and baseline run.
Report exact answer rate and unit correctness with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: accepting a plausible wrong magnitude.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of numeracy.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report exact answer rate and unit correctness against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for accepting a plausible wrong magnitude; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
